description: This Java class defines the PolicyReferenceTag, which encapsulates the ID and revision of a policy, along with the ID of an entity referencing this policy. It includes methods for creating instances, JSON serialization/deserialization, and standard object overrides.

classes.name: PolicyReferenceTag
classes.description: Immutable class representing a reference to a policy, including entity ID and policy tag, with JSON serialization/deserialization capabilities.

classes.name: PolicyReferenceTag.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains static definitions of JSON field names used within PolicyReferenceTag for consistent JSON parsing and generation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new PolicyReferenceTag instance from an entity ID and policy tag.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a PolicyReferenceTag instance by parsing a given JSON object.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID associated with the policy reference.

methods.name: getPolicyTag
methods.description: Returns the policy tag associated with the policy reference.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the PolicyReferenceTag to a JSON object.

methods.name: asIdentifierString
methods.description: Generates a string identifier combining entity ID and policy revision.
